A1_SURVIVES: (A: delta-AIC > 4 favouring QUAD for >= half of eligible ideas OR B: >=1 significant top-3 reversal at T<=1.6) AND C: path-multiplicity Spearman >= 0.6 (pooled)
C1: >=75% of the 90 forked samples have t* <= 47 (TV<=0.125 to final label for all t'>=t*) AND are single-dominant (k_BIC<=1 or largest single segment jump >= 0.6 x total rise y_0->y_47)
C2: median Arrhenius R^2 >= 0.85 over eligible ideas (all tasks pooled) AND zero SIGNIFICANT top-3 rank reversals at T<=1.3 (bootstrap 95% CI of share difference excludes 0 in flipped direction, 2000 resamples)
C3: slope-gap Spearman >= 0.6 on >= 2 of 3 tasks; tasks with <3 eligible non-mode ideas are 'not evaluable'; if <2 tasks evaluable, pooled Spearman >= 0.6 is used and the substitution reported
VERDICT: 'H' if H only, 'A1' if A1 only, 'ambiguous' otherwise; every sub-criterion reported with value/threshold/pass

definitions.A1_C_target: share_j(T=1.6) - share_j(T=0.7), ideas with share >= 3% at either T, pooled over tasks
definitions.arrhenius: binary logit of j vs mode over 6 temperatures: LIN log-odds = c - s/T vs QUAD + q/T^2; ML on raw counts; delta-AIC = AIC_lin - AIC_quad; R^2 from WLS on +0.5-smoothed empirical log-odds, weights 1/var
definitions.commitment: t* = smallest t with TV(o_t', onehot(final)) <= 0.125 for all t' in [t,47]; 8 rollouts, T=0.7, 320 tokens
definitions.eligible: share >= 3% at T=1.0 (top_k=none), excluding 'other' and the mode
definitions.gap: median over forked base paths of u_mode - u_j at t*, u_j = max log p(w) over idea-j tokens (T=1 logits); missing -> log p of the 20th token (upper bound on u_j)
definitions.mode: most frequent idea at T=0.3 (ties broken at T=0.5), top_k=none
definitions.path_multiplicity: M_j = mean over base paths with final label != j of #{t in 1..47: share_j(o_t) >= 1/8}

primary_sample: n=100 per cell (sample_idx 0..99, seed = sample_idx), top_k = none (-1) for Arrhenius/reversals
secondary_not_in_verdict: beta of slope ~ gap regression (H predicts ~1)
steepness ratio d log alpha_1/dT / d log beta_1/dT >= 3
